steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to EspoCRM at http://127.0.0.1:8097/ with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type that literal text exactly as shown). Then go to Opportunities list, find and report the exact names of all opportunities whose name starts with 'Seed:'. Report them exactly.

02-create: In EspoCRM, create a new Opportunity with name '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity'. Set the Account link field to the account named exactly 'Bench Account' (choose it from the suggestions or select dialog so it is actually linked — other accounts have similar names). Set stage to 'Negotiation', amount to 12500 (default currency), close date to 2026-12-31, and assign the Assigned User field to the user named exactly 'Bench Assignee' (choose from suggestions/select dialog so it is actually linked). In the Description field include the text '{{runid}}'. Save the record, then open its detail page and report the values shown for name, account, stage, amount, close date, assigned user, and description.

03-verify: On the Opportunity detail page for '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' (id {{02-create.url.h2}}), post a note on the Stream panel whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. '{{runid}} bench note'). Verify the post appears in the Stream. Also confirm the close date shown is 2026-12-31 (check the field value including year — hover or edit if needed) and report the post text and the close date.
